e.summary: **Dynamic Geographic Ratemaking under Tail Risk**（Zenodo `10.5281/zenodo.22826154`）**是一份**把**「**地理分区」**当**成**尾部**风险**下**的**决策**、**而**不是**平滑**技巧**的**精算**数据包****——**逐字标题**为**「**Data and Reproducibility Materials for Dynamic Geographic Ratemaking under Tail Risk: A Distributional Reinforcement Learning Approach**」**。**本次实测**：**⭐ 发布日 **2026-09-18****（**窗口内）**、**类型逐字 **`dataset`****、**许可逐字 **`cc-by-4.0`****、**作者逐字 **`Fredy, POKOU`****、**文件**逐字**为 **`Data_IME.zip`（**232,780,219 B）**与 **`Results_IME.zip`（**349,332,091 B）**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**非 **GitHub** 的**代码**托管面**」**——**⭐ 而**它**是**本轮**按**已**核实**候选**收**入**的**一条**（**⭐ 上轮**已**记录**在**案，**本**轮**立**条**以免**重复**劳动）**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **它**把**「**怎么**划**地理**区」**写**成**尾部**风险**下**的**决策**问题****——**⭐ 逐字**「**spatial risk information is converted into admissible geographic classifications and territorial pricing decisions**」**——**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**对 **RIAA** 最有用**：**⭐ 即**车险**与**家财**险里**「**按**地区**定价**」**通**常**被**当**成**技术**活**（**聚类**、**平滑**、**可信**度**加权）**，**而**这**里**把**它**写**成**「**在**尾部**风险**约束**下**选**一**组**可**接受**的**分区**方案**」**——**⭐ 即**分区**边**界**本身**是**决策**变量**；**② **它**用**分位**数**型**强化**学习**直接**学**分布**，**而**不**只**学**均值****（**逐字**：**mean-based and quantile-based reinforcement learning procedures**）**——**⭐ 即**关心**的**是**「**累积**回报**的**尾部**」**而**非**期望**；**③ **它**的**评**价**准**则**把**「**期望**」**与**「**尾部**」**放**在**同**一**式**里****（**逐字**：**a precommitment criterion combining expected cumulative actuarial return with Tail Value at Risk of adverse cumulative return**）**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**凡**是**「**既要**收益**又要**控**尾部」**的**决策**，**都**可以**借**这个**结构**；**④ ⚠️ **它**逐字**声**明**数据**边界**（**逐字**：**The French application is a calibrated actuarial experiment. Public geographic, hazard, and exposure-proxy information is used to parameterize the actuarial environment; the repository does not contain observed French insurance claims or insurer exposure data.**）**——**⭐ 本词条**据此**提示**：**⭐ 即**「**法国**案例」**这**类**说法**很**容易**被**读者**当**成**实证**研究**，**而**这**句**话**主**动**切**断**了**这**条**误**读**（**⭐ 与**第 **378** 轮**「**样本** vs **全量」**、**第 **379** 轮**「**合成** vs **真实」**、**第 **380** 轮**「**覆盖**率**不是**总体**样本」**同**属**一**脉）**。**⚠️ 本次**未下载**其 **zip**、**未重跑**其**任何**结果**。
e.body:
**Dynamic Geographic Ratemaking under Tail Risk**（Zenodo `10.5281/zenodo.22826154`）**是一份**把**「**地理分区」**当**成**尾部**风险**下**的**决策**、**而**不是**平滑**技巧**的**精算**数据包****——**逐字标题**为**「**Data and Reproducibility Materials for Dynamic Geographic Ratemaking under Tail Risk: A Distributional Reinforcement Learning Approach**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**非 **GitHub** 的**代码**托管面**」**。
**可核实信息（均 2026-09-23 Zenodo 记录接口实测）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它**把**「**怎么**划**地理**区」**写**成**尾部**风险**下**的**决策**问题**，**而**不**是**技术**细节****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**描述**逐字**写**「**The study develops a finite-horizon sequential actuarial framework in which spatial risk information is converted into admissible geographic classifications and territorial pricing decisions.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**对 **RIAA** 最有用**：**⭐ 即**「**按**地区**定价」**在**实务**里**常**被**拆**成**两**件**互**不**相**干**的**事**（**数据**侧**聚类**、**定价**侧**给**相对**数**），**而**这**里**把**两**者**合**成**一**个**序贯**决策**：**⭐ 先**选**一**组**可**接受**的**分区**，**再**在**分区**上**定**价**，**且**「**可**接受」**由**尾部**风险**定义**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**写**地区**定价**作业**时**，**把**「**分区**方案**的**选择」**也**当**成**要**交代**的**决策**，**而**不**只**交代**聚类**算法**。
**⭐⭐ ② 它**用**分位**数**型**强化**学习**直接**表示**分布**，**而**不**只**学**均值****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**描述**逐字**写**「**Policy-conditional cumulative-return distributions are represented using mean-based and quantile-based reinforcement learning procedures**」**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**分布**型**强化**学习」**与**「**学**一**个**期望**」**的**区别**在**于**前**者**保留**了**尾部**形状**，**故**能**直接**评**价**「**坏**情况**有**多**坏」**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**当**目标**函**数**里**含**「**尾部**」**（**监管**资本**、**再保**层**、**偿付**能力）**时**，**只**优**化**均值**的**方法**在**结构**上**就**不**够**用**。
**⭐⭐ ③ 它**的**评价**准**则**把**「**期望**回报」**与**「**不利**累积**回报**的 **Tail Value at Risk」**写**进**同**一**式****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**描述**逐字**写**「**evaluated under a precommitment criterion combining expected cumulative actuarial return with Tail Value at Risk of adverse cumulative return**」**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**precommitment（**事**先**承诺**的**准则）**」**这**个**词**很**关键**——**⭐ 它**意味**着**准**则**在**看**到**结**果**之前**就**定**好**，**而**不**是**事**后**挑**一**个**好**看**的**指标**报**告**（**⭐ 与**第 **379** 轮 **VaR** 审计**的**预注册**精神**同**源）**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**做**模型**比较**时**，**把**评价**准则**写在**跑**实验**之前**。
**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 它**逐字**声**明**数据**边界**，**主**动**切**断**「**实验**当**实证」**的**误**读****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**描述**逐字**末尾**写**「**The French application is a calibrated actuarial experiment. Public geographic, hazard, and exposure-proxy information is used to parameterize the actuarial environment; the repository does not contain observed French insurance claims or insurer exposure data.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**是**本条**价值**最高**的**一**句**：**⭐ 即**「**法国**应用」**这**类**说法**极**容易**被**读者**（**以及**引用**它**的**二手**材料）**当**成**「**在**法国**数据**上**做**的**实证**研究」**，**而**这**句**话**明确**说**：**环境**是**用**公开**地理**、**灾害**与**暴露**代理**变量**参数**化**的**校准**实验**，**仓库**里**没有**观察**到**的**赔付**与**承保**暴露**数据**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**引**用**「**某国**案例」**时**，**先**问**「**数据**是**观察**到**的**还**是**校准**出**来**的」**——**⭐ 这**正**是**第 **378／379／380** 三轮**反复**出现**的**同**一**类**判**断**（**样本／**全量、**合成／**真实、**语料／**总体**）。
**⭐⭐ ⑤ 交付**形态**与**可**核**对**信息****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**发布日 **2026-09-18****（**窗口内）**、**类型逐字 **`dataset`****、**许可逐字 **`cc-by-4.0`****、**作者逐字 **`Fredy, POKOU`****、**文件**逐字**为 **`Data_IME.zip`（**232,780,219 B）**与 **`Results_IME.zip`（**349,332,091 B）**；**⭐ 描述**逐字**说明**交付**含**「**the processed inputs, numerical outputs, and supporting materials required to reproduce the figures, tables, policy comparisons, stress evaluations, and sensitivity analyses reported in the paper**」**；**⭐ 本词条**如实**指出**：**⭐ 即**它**把**「**处理**后**输入」**与**「**数值**输出」**分**两个**压缩**包**（**约 **222 MiB** 与 **333 MiB）**，**读者**可**只**取**结果**包**看**数**（**⭐ 本词条**未**下载**，**故**不**主张**其**内容**与**可**复现**性）**。
**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[insurance-spatial]] 覆盖**空间**风险**方法**、**[[insurance-quantile]] 覆盖**分位**数**建模**、**[[reproducible-actuarial-work]] 覆盖**精算**可**复现**工作**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**把**地理**分区**当**决策**变量、**以**分位**数**型**强化**学习**学**分布**、**并**在**事先**承诺**的**期望＋**尾部**准则**下**评价」这一**形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。
**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **把**分区**方案**当**决策**而**非**技术**细节**；**② **关**心**尾部**时**要**学**分布**而**不**只**学**均值**；**③ **评价**准则**要**事先**承诺**；**④ **引**用**「**某国**案例」**前**先**问**数据**来源**类型**；**⑤ **输入**包**与**结果**包**分开**交付**，**便于**读者**按**需要**取**。
**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有下载**其**任何**压缩**包（**232,780,219 B 与 **349,332,091 B）**、**未运行**其**代码**、**未重跑**其**任何**结果**，**故**不**主张**其**可**复现**性**、**数值**正确性**或**结论**稳健**性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**Zenodo** 记录**接口**返回的**元数据与描述**（**描述**实测 **1,146** 字符）**，**未读**其**代码**、**数据**或**论文**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**与**任何**论文**的**对应**关系**（**描述**提到 **`the paper` 但**未**给**论文 **DOI）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**「**公开**地理**、**灾害**与**暴露**代理**变量」**的**具体**来源**与**授权**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**分位**数**型**强化**学习**的**实现**与**超参**。**⑥ ⚠️ 窗口**状况**：**发布日 **2026-09-18** 落在**本轮**窗口**之内**（**基准日 **2026-09-23）**，**故**无需**缺口**说明**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-23 所见**；**⚠️ 使用**其**校准**环境**做**定价**或**资本**结论**前**须**自行**验证**。

e.title_en: A data and reproducibility package that treats geographic classification as a decision under tail risk rather than as a smoothing exercise: it converts spatial risk information into admissible geographic classifications and territorial pricing decisions, represents policy-conditional cumulative-return distributions with mean-based and quantile-based reinforcement learning, evaluates them under a criterion combining expected cumulative actuarial return with the tail value at risk of adverse return, and states plainly that the repository contains no observed insurance claims or insurer exposure data because the national application is a calibrated experiment built on public proxy variables.
e.title_hk: **一份**把**「**地理分區」**當成**尾部風險下的**決策**、**而非**平滑技巧的精算數據包****：`geographic-ratemaking-tail-risk-materials`——**⭐ 逐字標題為**「**Data and Reproducibility Materials for Dynamic Geographic Ratemaking under Tail Risk: A Distributional Reinforcement Learning Approach**」**；**⭐ 方法逐字**：**把空間風險信息**「**converted into admissible geographic classifications and territorial pricing decisions**」**，**並用均值型與**分位數型**強化學習表示**「**policy-conditional cumulative-return distributions**」**；**⭐ 而它逐字劃出最關鍵的邊界**：**「**the repository does not contain observed French insurance claims or insurer exposure data**」**——**⭐ 即**法國案例是用公開代理變量校準的實驗**，**不是真實賠付數據**
e.summary_en: This is a data and reproducibility package that treats geographic classification as a decision under tail risk rather than as a smoothing exercise, and its title names dynamic geographic ratemaking under tail risk through a distributional reinforcement learning approach. **Measured this round**: released on the eighteenth of September inside the window, typed as a dataset, licensed for attribution use, credited to one author, and shipped as two archives of about two hundred and thirty and about three hundred and fifty megabytes. **This round theme is the non-GitHub code hosting surface, and this entry was collected from a candidate verified in the previous round and recorded then to avoid duplicated work.** **Four things are worth reading: it writes how to draw geographic areas as a decision problem under tail risk, converting spatial risk information into admissible geographic classifications and territorial pricing decisions, which matters because territorial pricing in motor and home insurance is usually treated as a technical exercise in clustering, smoothing, and credibility weighting, whereas here the boundaries themselves are decision variables; it learns distributions rather than only means, using mean-based and quantile-based reinforcement learning procedures, so what is modelled is the tail of cumulative return rather than its expectation; its evaluation criterion puts expectation and tail in one expression, namely a precommitment criterion combining expected cumulative actuarial return with the tail value at risk of adverse cumulative return, a structure worth borrowing for any decision that must both earn and control the tail; and it states the data boundary in writing, saying that the national application is a calibrated actuarial experiment parameterised with public geographic, hazard, and exposure-proxy information, and that the repository contains no observed insurance claims or insurer exposure data, which cuts the easy misreading of a calibrated experiment as an empirical study, in the same line as earlier notes on samples versus full data, synthetic versus real files, and coverage that is not a population sample.** **No archive was downloaded and no result was rerun this round.**

e.body_en:
This is a data and reproducibility package that treats geographic classification as a decision under tail risk rather than as a smoothing exercise. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the non-GitHub code hosting surface.**
**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-23 from the record interface**:
**First, it writes how to draw geographic areas as a decision problem under tail risk rather than as a technical detail.** The description states that the study develops a finite-horizon sequential actuarial framework in which spatial risk information is converted into admissible geographic classifications and territorial pricing decisions. **Territorial pricing is usually split into two disconnected activities, clustering on the data side and assigning relativities on the pricing side, whereas this framework makes a sequential decision of them: first choose a set of admissible territories, then price within them, with admissibility defined by tail risk, so coursework on territorial pricing should present the choice of territory scheme as a decision to justify rather than only the clustering algorithm.**
**Second, it represents distributions with quantile-based rather than only mean-based learning.** The description states that policy-conditional cumulative-return distributions are represented using mean-based and quantile-based reinforcement learning procedures. **Distributional learning retains the shape of the tail while learning an expectation discards it, so when the objective contains a tail, as regulatory capital, reinsurance layers, and solvency requirements do, mean-only methods are structurally insufficient.**
**Third, its evaluation criterion puts expected return and tail risk in one expression.** The description states that policies are evaluated under a precommitment criterion combining expected cumulative actuarial return with the tail value at risk of adverse cumulative return. **The word precommitment matters: the criterion is fixed before results are seen rather than selected afterwards from whichever metric looks best, which is the same spirit as the pre-registration recorded in an earlier round, and the practice transfers to any model comparison.**
**Fourth, it states the data boundary in writing and thereby cuts the misreading of an experiment as an empirical study.** The description ends by saying that the national application is a calibrated actuarial experiment, that public geographic, hazard, and exposure-proxy information parameterises the actuarial environment, and that the repository contains no observed claims or insurer exposure data. **A phrase like the national application is easily read, including by second-hand citations, as a study conducted on that country data, so naming what the environment is calibrated from and what data are absent is the highest-value sentence here. Citing a country case should always start from whether the data are observed or calibrated, which is the same judgement class that appeared across the previous three rounds as sample versus full data, synthetic versus real files, and corpus versus population.**
**Fifth, delivery shape and verified facts.** Released on the eighteenth of September inside the window, typed as a dataset, licensed for attribution use, credited to one author, and shipped as two archives of roughly two hundred and thirty and three hundred and fifty megabytes, with the description stating that the package holds the processed inputs, numerical outputs, and supporting materials needed to reproduce the figures, tables, policy comparisons, stress evaluations, and sensitivity analyses. **Splitting inputs and results into separate archives lets a reader take only the results, though nothing was downloaded here so no claim is made about contents or reproducibility.**
**Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover spatial risk methods, quantile modelling, and reproducible actuarial work, **while this entry supplies the form of a package that makes territory choice a decision variable, learns distributions by quantile-based reinforcement learning, and evaluates under a precommitted expectation-plus-tail criterion. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**
**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: treat the territory scheme as a decision rather than a detail; learn distributions when the tail matters; precommit the evaluation criterion; ask what kind of data underlie a country case before citing it; and ship inputs and results as separate artefacts.**
**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no archive was downloaded, no code was run, and no result was rerun**, so no claim is made about reproducibility, numerical correctness, or robustness. **Second, only metadata and description, measured at about eleven hundred characters, were read**, not the code, the data, or any paper. **Third, the correspondence with any paper was not verified**, the description mentioning a paper without an identifier. **Fourth, the provenance and licensing of the public proxy variables were not verified. Fifth, the reinforcement learning implementation and hyperparameters were not verified. Sixth, the release date falls inside this round window against a baseline of the twenty-third of September. Seventh, this entry records what was visible on that date and states plainly that drawing pricing or capital conclusions from its calibrated environment requires independent verification.**

**Dynamic Geographic Ratemaking under Tail Risk**（Zenodo `10.5281/zenodo.22826154`）**是一份**把**「**地理分區」**當成**尾部風險下的決策**、**而不是平滑技巧的精算數據包****——**逐字標題**為**「**Data and Reproducibility Materials for Dynamic Geographic Ratemaking under Tail Risk: A Distributional Reinforcement Learning Approach**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**非 GitHub 的代碼託管面**」**。
**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-23 Zenodo 記錄介面實測）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① 把怎麼劃地理區寫成尾部風險下的決策問題**——**逐字**spatial risk information is converted into admissible geographic classifications and territorial pricing decisions.**；**⭐ 即**「**按地區定價」**常被拆成聚類與給相對數兩件事**，**而這裡合成一個序貫決策**，**且「**可接受」**由尾部風險定義**。
**⭐⭐ ② 用分位數型強化學習直接表示分布**——**逐字**Policy-conditional cumulative-return distributions are represented using mean-based and quantile-based reinforcement learning procedures.**；**⭐ 即**保留尾部形狀**，**故能直接評價壞情況有多壞**。
**⭐⭐ ③ 評價準則把期望與尾部寫進同一式**——**逐字**evaluated under a precommitment criterion combining expected cumulative actuarial return with Tail Value at Risk of adverse cumulative return.**；**⭐ 即**準則在看結果之前就定好**，**而不是事後挑好看的指標**（**與第 379 輪 VaR 審計的預註冊精神同源**）**。
**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 逐字聲明數據邊界**——**逐字**The French application is a calibrated actuarial experiment. Public geographic, hazard, and exposure-proxy information is used to parameterize the actuarial environment; the repository does not contain observed French insurance claims or insurer exposure data.**；**⭐ 即**主動切斷「**法國案例當成在法國數據上做的實證研究」**的誤讀**（**與第 378／379／380 輪同一類判斷**）**。
**⭐⭐ ⑤ 交付形態與可核對資訊**——**發布日 2026-09-18**、**類型 `dataset`**、**許可 `cc-by-4.0`**、**作者 `Fredy, POKOU`**、**文件 `Data_IME.zip`（232,780,219 B）與 `Results_IME.zip`（349,332,091 B）**；**⭐ 即**輸入包與結果包分開交付**。
**⭐⭐ ⑥ 與池內條目的關係**：[[insurance-spatial]]、[[insurance-quantile]]、[[reproducible-actuarial-work]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**把地理分區當決策變量、**以分位數型強化學習學分布、**並在事先承諾的期望＋**尾部準則下評價**」**這一形態**。
